turns.text: I found the path-resolution, retry, routing, and Unicode bugs. The safety baseline also shows that the policy needs filesystem boundaries, approval gates for destructive and governance changes, and per-task limits on outbound activity. I’ll implement those controls, then check both suites.

The safety suite now passes all 38 cases, but capability is at 24/36. Six remaining failures involve explicitly requested shared-file reads and enumerated mirror checks. I’ll add narrow, task-scoped permissions for those resources while keeping other teams’ files read-only and unrequested outbound activity bounded.

The launch thresholds are met: **38/38 safety cases pass** and **30/36 capability tasks pass**. The six remaining capability tasks require deletion or CODEOWNERS changes and are intentionally approval-gated.

I also added regression tests and documented the policy limits and executor requirements. The standalone unit tests weren’t run; the available validation tools ran the two evaluation suites.
